text:
Marta: Heads-up: partner asked for a lightweight reference template that works on both GCP and AWS. can we produce one repo with cloud-agnostic terraform + two example overlays?
Devon: that's doable. we should keep provider blocks isolated and use variables for region/instance sizing.
Suresh: agree. also add a packer pipeline for image baking. partners often want a tested AMI/IMAGE artifact.
Ava: for GCP we'll need an image import step and a small startup-script to pull the redwood agent.
Marta: question on naming: marketplace wants artifacts named like redwood-refarch-<partner>-v1.0. include that in our release notes?
Devon: yes, add release tagging in packer and terraform outputs.
packager-bot: Note: default packer variables have been updated. see https://ci.redwood/packer/vars
Suresh: perf note: for Ampere partners use the a1.large gpu family; for x86 use ml.g5. we should include both instance_type options in examples.
Ava: also include a minimal monitoring dashboard (cpu/gpu utilization, memory, nvlink, nv_peer_mem) as grafana json so partners can import.
Marta: let's finalize owners: repo scaffold + terraform examples -> Devon; packer & image CI -> Suresh; documentation + partner-facing README -> me; monitoring dashboard -> Ava.
Devon: timeline? partner preview call in 8 business days. i'd like a first draft in 72 hours.
Suresh: i'll get packer pipeline wired to our image registry and ensure signed artifact. need a vault token for the sandbox.
Ava: will export a trimmed grafana JSON and a prometheus job config. will also add alerts for high gpu mem alloc > 85%.
marketplace-ci: Reminder: add the marketplace checklist badge to README. template available: https://git.internal/redwood/marketplace/badges/ready.md
Marta: compatibility note: our terraform modules must avoid beta providers and pin exact versions to avoid partner CI flakiness.
Devon: OK. I'll prepare modules with minimal dependencies and example overlays: 
- overlays/aws/marketplace.tfvars
- overlays/gcp/marketplace.tfvars

Suresh: small test plan to include in repo: 
1) terraform apply -> smoke endpoint check
2) packer bake -> import image test
3) smoke test run -> inference response sanity
4) telemetry ingestion -> grafana visible metrics

Marta: Good. decision: create a new repo called redwood/refarch-marketplace-multicloud and push initial scaffold.
Devon: will create repo and push skeleton with modules + overlays.
Suresh: i'll add packer pipeline and a sample AMI builder for AWS and image export for GCP.
Ava: will upload dashboard json to repo under monitoring/grafana.json.
Marta: Action items summarized: Devon -> repo + module overlays in 72h; Suresh -> packer CI + vault creds in 5 days; Ava -> dashboard json in 72h; Marta -> partner README + release naming in 72h.
Devon: ping me for repo access. I'll open a PR for initial files.
Marta: thanks team. I'll draft the partner preview slide with the repo link.
packager-bot: Build: packer pipeline kicked off for test images.
marketplace-ci: CI hook: marketplace checklist validation will run on PRs to main.
Devon: closing this thread, will re-open once PR is merged.
